48.original: Upon speaking with Peshekwa, several cutscenes will play in sequence.

49.original: It is recommended that you set aside sufficient time to view these scenes in their entirety.

50.original: Welcome back. And may I congratulate you on Wuk Lamat's victory in the rite of succession.

51.original: It is our great honor to host the comrades of our future Dawnservant.

52.original: Such a grand journey has doubtless left you fatigued. Please relax and enjoy your stay.

54.original: Surprised to see me? I suppose it's only natural...

57.original: That my sister was able to realize her potential is testament to the quality of her traveling companions. Particularly you.

58.original: For that, you have my heartfelt gratitude.

60.original: I only did as you might have in my position.

61.original: Wuk Lamat did all the work. I was just moral support.

62.original: My primary business in calling is to deliver a message from Lamaty'i. As you well know, after the ascension ceremony she will officially take up the mantle of Dawnservant.

63.original: She has expressed a desire for you to accept a post within her administration...

65.original: You needn't decide immediately. My sister will broach the matter with you again after the ceremony.

66.original: Whether you continue to assist Lamaty'i or not is up to you.

67.original: That is all. If you'll excuse me.

68.original: ...You have become someone irreplaceable to her. As her brother, I acknowledge that with no little jealousy.

69.original: But believe me when I say that I hope you will stay by her side.

78.original: She might have told <hex:021A020203>someone<hex:021A020103> what she was planning...

79.original: But Wuk Lamat does not act without the best interests of her people in mind.

80.original: The Head of Reason was very wise indeed to devise something so elaborate and meaningful as the rite of succession. 'Tis a shame he could not be here to bear witness to the end.

81.original: A bittersweet celebration to be sure, but I'm glad Wuk Lamat finally got the recognition she deserves.

82.original: Wuk Lamat was brilliant up there, wasn't she?

83.original: The part with the Second Promise was surprising, but between the two of them, I daresay our new Dawnservants will be capable of anything.

84.original: The future of Tuliyollal is bright indeed.
